clue.text: Like one seen with a jerk from a considerable distance

parts.note: like, as in 'do as I do', gives AS
one is the Roman numeral I
a tic is an involuntary jerk or twitch

explanation.surface: Someone spotted far off, twitching as they go.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: something from Asia comes from far away, at least as the setter sees it from Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Of Asian origin, i.e. coming from the distant East as seen from Europe.

clue.text: Russian leader in a fix? That's illuminating!

indicators.note: in says that first letter goes inside the following pieces

parts.note: a clamp fixes things in place

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Russian boss gets into trouble, which explains everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fix' suggests a predicament; it is the clamp.
explanation.definitionFit: An electric lamp producing light from an arc between electrodes.

clue.text: Visible percipience

explanation.surface: Clear perception on display.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words the answer means visible.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep understanding; and, as two words, within view.

clue.text: Connect its return with a German

indicators.note: return says the word is turned to read backwards

parts.note: read as it's, the pronoun it plus a possessive ending
ein is German for a

explanation.surface: Link a returned item to a German.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe of 'its' is ignored, so only the pronoun is turned round; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To tie in is to link or be consistent with something.

clue.text: Thinks to bamboozle supporters

parts.note: to con is to trick or bamboozle
siders are those who side with a person, i.e. supporters

explanation.surface: Means to fool the fans.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or reflect on something.

clue.text: Pressing takes no more than a moment

definitions.meaning: pressing means urgent, demanding immediate attention
a moment is a very brief span of time

explanation.surface: Something urgent that will only take a second.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: an urgent demand, and a split second of time.

clue.text: Copy one thousand, given time

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Duplicating a thousand pages, if you have the time.
explanation.definitionFit: A likeness or representation, i.e. a copy.

clue.text: A charming woman!

parts.note: charming read literally: a woman who casts charms or spells, not a delightful one

explanation.surface: A compliment to a delightful lady.
explanation.definitionFit: A witch casts charms, so she is literally charming.

clue.text: Stuck with awkward redhead

indicators.note: awkward means clumsily arranged, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Lumbered with a difficult ginger.
explanation.definitionFit: Clung fast or kept to something, i.e. stuck.

clue.text: Building worker going about double-parking-and he drinks!

indicators.note: going about means surrounding, so the worker goes round the other piece

parts.note: a tiler lays tiles on buildings

indicators.note: double says the parking letter appears twice in a row

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A builder who double-parks his van and drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A habitual drinker of alcohol.

clue.text: The reservoir cretins vandalised

indicators.note: something vandalised is wrecked and broken up, so the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Idiots have smashed up the local water supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A tank storing water is a small reservoir.

clue.text: Ventilates the joint, showing a certain craft

parts.note: to air a room is to ventilate it, so ventilates gives airs
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: Someone opens windows to clear the smoke from a joint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The joint' suggests a cannabis cigarette or a dive bar; it is the body's hip.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirigible is a kind of aircraft, the craft meant here.

clue.text: Land 23 down in an awful mess

indicators.note: an awful mess is a jumble, signalling these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the solution of 23 down is greet

explanation.surface: A country where everything has gone badly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue's 'Land' would usually be a country noun; ARGENTINE is an old name for Argentina, as in 'the Argentine'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argentine is an older name for the South American country Argentina.

clue.text: Record among the Top Ten-Rolling Stones number

indicators.note: among says the letters sit inside the following run of words

explanation.surface: A Rolling Stones song makes the charts.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'Ten-Rolling'; 'Record' looks like a noun for a disc but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrol is to enter a name on a register, i.e. to record it.

clue.text: Quietly a hard worker makes a comeback in India

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

indicators.note: making a comeback means coming back, so the word is read in the other direction

parts.note: the ant is proverbially industrious

explanation.surface: A diligent worker quietly returns to India.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the place: a city found in India, on the Ganges.
explanation.definitionFit: Patna is the capital city of Bihar state in India.

clue.text: Acknowledging a letter for publicity?

indicators.note: for here means standing in front of, so publicity precedes the letter

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
a missive is a letter

explanation.surface: Confirming receipt of a promotional letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter' suggests a character of the alphabet; it is a written message.
explanation.definitionFit: Tending to admit or concede, i.e. acknowledging.

clue.text: A Cockney wants endless comfort and loving

indicators.note: endless says the word for comfort loses its final letter

parts.note: ease means comfort
tender means loving and gentle

explanation.surface: A Cockney who needs ease and affection.
explanation.walkthrough: An East Ender comes from the East End of London, the traditional Cockney district.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of London's East End, home of the Cockney.

clue.text: She aimed to get a tan-a burn's the unfortunate result

definitions.text: She aimed to get a tan

indicators.note: unfortunate suggests things have gone wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A sun-lover hoping to brown is left with sunburn.
explanation.walkthrough: The page's 'can' is a scanning slip for 'tan'.
explanation.definitionFit: One who lies in the sun to brown the skin.

clue.text: Member of a secret society using forenames

indicators.note: using here means putting the letters to work in another arrangement

explanation.surface: A secret society member refers to colleagues by first names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'using' is an unusual anagram signal: the letters of 'forenames' are used to make something else.
explanation.definitionFit: The Freemasons are a fraternal order known for secret rituals.

clue.text: Stopped for a wearying individual

parts.note: a bore is a tiresome person

explanation.surface: Someone halted because of a tedious person.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbore means refrained or held back from doing something.

clue.text: The choosy person's marked preference

parts.note: read literally: a person who chooses, marking a preference with a cross on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: A fussy person's favoured option.
explanation.definitionFit: A voter chooses a candidate by marking a ballot.

clue.text: A villain's way with temporary accommodation

parts.note: a way is a direction, here S for south
a camp is temporary lodging such as tents

explanation.surface: A villain sets up a makeshift camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way' as a direction gives S; the 's of 'villain's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A scamp is a rascal or mischievous rogue.

clue.text: One holding on-it is such a bloomer

indicators.note: holding says the ace goes around the other letters

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
the two words on and it taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone clings on, calling it a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a mistake; it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Monkshood is a flowering plant, so something that blooms.

clue.text: A gratuity for being in attendance

definitions.meaning: a gratuity is a tip or gift

explanation.surface: A tip for turning up.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift; and here, on the spot rather than absent.

clue.text: Fishing tackle that gets the right fish

parts.note: eels are fish

explanation.surface: Angling gear that lands the right catch.
explanation.definitionFit: Spools that wind in a fishing line are part of an angler's equipment.

clue.text: This politician appeared moved about a youth on the street

indicators.note: about says the word for moved goes around the other pieces

parts.note: moved, i.e. went away, gives gone

indicators.note: on says the youth comes before the street

parts.note: a lad is a youth
ST is the abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: A politician turned up, wandering about after a young lad on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: William Gladstone was a Victorian Liberal prime minister of Britain.

clue.text: Receive round-about welcome

indicators.note: round says the word for receive goes around the next piece

parts.note: to get is to receive
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Getting a lukewarm reception.
explanation.definitionFit: To greet someone is to welcome them.

clue.text: Given direction, scraps catalogues

parts.note: S is south, a compass direction
orts are scraps of leftover food

explanation.surface: Once directed, someone discards the catalogues.
explanation.definitionFit: To sort is to classify or arrange, much as a catalogue does.

clue.text: The exterior is due to undergo renovation

indicators.note: to undergo renovation is to be rebuilt, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The outside of the building needs a makeover.
explanation.definitionFit: The outer surface or part of something.

clue.text: Drug taken by English woman being very brave

indicators.note: taken by says the drug comes before the next piece

parts.note: heroin is an opiate drug

explanation.surface: An Englishwoman takes drugs and shows great courage.
explanation.definitionFit: A female figure admired for courage.

clue.text: A pledge that's absolutely serious

definitions.meaning: a token payment made as a pledge of more to follow
fully sincere and grave in intent

explanation.surface: A promise made in complete seriousness.
explanation.definitionFit: A deposit given to seal a bargain; and sincere, solemn in manner.

clue.text: Appreciate courtesy

definitions.meaning: to appreciate is to value or esteem

explanation.surface: Value good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: To esteem someone; and the deference or politeness shown to them.
